processNotes.phase11GateIsOwed: Branch B ran parallel to the spine and its phase boundary was never adjudicated. Lenses per plan 7.2: correctness, protocol-conformance, concurrency, plus standing spec-conformance and the >=10-malformed-request red-team-by-data probe (the orchestrator executes the candidates against the exported pure functions and compares verdicts; an admitted input is a mechanically confirmed finding needing no skeptic round).
processNotes.sameFileAgentsRunSequentially: C-056: three fixes to adapter/tools.ts were dispatched in parallel. A clobbered fix does not fail the gate - it is simply absent, and the test that would have caught it is clobbered with it. Sequencing comes from the file touched, not from how small the change looks.
processNotes.theRecurringDEFECTCLASS: C-044 through C-047 were one shape: a check that PASSED while inspecting less than it appeared to. A name-level equation blind to types; a grep blind to a binary file; an assertion satisfiable by two mechanisms so it pinned neither; a green suite over a product whose tools all throw. A construction that enforces an invariant must ALSO assert that it ran.
processNotes.mutationRevertTrap: A mutation harness that reverts with `git checkout <file>` DISCARDS UNCOMMITTED WORK. Snapshot with cp, restore from the snapshot, verify with cmp.
processNotes.agentStrayFileTrap: Test-writers told to typecheck by copying into conductor/tests/ and deleting have twice left or removed files at a path the orchestrator was also using. A CHANGED TEST COUNT is the tell. Run git status after ANY agent returns.
processNotes.readTheInterface: Read the exported SIGNATURE, never infer it from one call site.
processNotes.reviewResultTrap: An EMPTY finding set can mean the LENSES CRASHED. Check the run's failures and journal.jsonl before treating empty as a pass.
processNotes.userParallelWork: The user commits their own work on main concurrently. ALWAYS git add explicit paths, never -A, and never revert their files.
processNotes.wireContractFlake: conductor/tests/wire-contract.test.ts spawns a real `opencode serve`. Under heavy concurrent load its readiness probe times out and all 15 subtests CANCEL, failing the gate. Re-run on a quiet machine before treating a cancellation as a regression.
processNotes.reasoningModelEmptyContent: From the 11.8 live artifact: a reasoning model under a tight max_tokens spends the whole budget in reasoning_content and returns EMPTY content with status 200. This bites 12.1's per-role token budgets and any structured-output retry loop, which will spend the same budget the same way.
